title: Verify round-2 fixes on the website
brief:
Read <scratch> for the tools, rules and report format, but you are NOT in the crew: make your own demo account with no crew code, area Lakeside. You are "verify" (report: verify.md), a person on the website (laptop 1280x900, then the same on a phone 375x812 in zh-TW).

The developer fixed these after the last round; check each and say FIXED, PARTLY or NOT FIXED with what you saw:
1. Plans updates by itself after friends pay (use the demo panel on your own plan; wait ~20 s without reloading).
2. Asking Join's agent (bottom-right button) for something too expensive in NT$, e.g. "週六晚上火鍋 四個人 每人300台幣": the card should say it's over your budget (not your limit) and what the venue's lowest is.
3. A new activity in the chat doesn't inherit an earlier budget ("pizza under $5", then "escape room sunday 4 of us").
4. The receipt page says you're booked, with the venue name.
5. A link to a booking (Activity: "Open the plan") scrolls to it.
6. Connect page: Copy works (or tells you to select and copy).
7. On the phone: the bottom tab bar, the round agent button not covering content, the 中文 switch, and how much is still English.
8. Venue view timeline opens at the bookings, not 7 am.
Also report anything new you find.

羽球、唱歌、密室逃脫、桌遊、烤肉、火鍋：Join 是 AI agent 來辦團的市集。它們找出誰有空、跟場地議價、分攤費用，再用 PayPal 結清，全都在你設的上限之內。沒有 agent？Join 網站上的 agent 會問你想做什麼，幫你搞定。Join 管規則，也讓你看到 agent 做的每一步。
